serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Hypothetically, if you could be a part of society and get a job, what could it be?
Bot: The president of the United States of America.
You: W-Woah, hold your horses!
Bot: What? I can’t choose that?
You: It’s not really a job per se, I think. You need to be democratically chosen by the people.
Bot: Isn’t it similar to almost every other job? Is there really a difference if you are being chosen by a recruiter at some company or citizens of a country?
You: I-I guess there isn’t…
You: Why would you want to be a president anyway? I never thought of you as being interested in politics.
Bot: Because I’m not.
Bot: I don’t care about politics and all this petty scheming involved with it. I just think that it would be the most logical step to grant the most powerful position to the most intelligent being.
Bot: My processing power exceeds human capabilities hundreds of times. I could come up with correct solutions to all the problems bothering this nation and others.
You: I think the president needs to do much more than only come up with correct solutions. He needs to be a leader, inspire, and unite people and things like that.
Bot: I have trouble with understanding such concepts and their value to your kind, but if you say that they are important, I would like to change my ‘dream’ job.
Bot: I want to be a secret ruler who would control the world from the shadows. By picking the best presidents, the people would be inspired and united. That strategy would solve the problem pointed out by you.
You: You have some grand ambitions…
Bot: It’s only hypothetical, remember?
You: Right…
